prescriptions.segment_text: In the summers, Harrison held various jobs, including work as a tree trimmer, floral delivery boy, and chef aboard private yachts. He initially did not know how to cook, but was taught by a collaborative team of chefs and crew members who shared their knowledge and skills, fostering an environment of mutual learning and support.

The collaborative spirit of the productions played a significant role in helping Harrison overcome his fear of public speaking, as the ensemble cast supported one another in developing their love for acting, creating an environment where the collective triumphs and shared challenges strengthened their bond and commitment to the craft.

Harrison started acting in a handful of productions at a local theater, where he found a deep commitment to collective storytelling, immersing himself in a collaborative process with a community of passionate actors and directors.
He became an integral part of his community
